scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible standalone computations are provided; numerical tests do not certify asymptotic statements. No human or independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-size disjoint approval blocs; independent and identically distributed nonnegative qualities with finite first moment. The general CLT fixes the candidate count per bloc and additionally assumes finite second moment and a positive continuous density at the relevant quantile. Does not generalize to all approval profiles or correlated qualities. Full original text of one closely related recent preprint was inaccessible; priority remains qualified.
title: Exact stochastic price of justified representation for equal party lists
